	# Buyer asks a Western country; size is picked in the send window. The seller answers by event one day later.
	COLDWAR_EB_contract_buy = {
		allowed = { always = yes }
		visible = {
			has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
			ROOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_member }
		}
		selectable = {
			NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_EB_ct_not_sealed_tt
				ROOT = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_info = 3 } } }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_EB_ct_none_tt
				NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_EB_ct_end@THIS > global.num_days } }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_EB_ct_not_pending_tt
				NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_EB_ct_pend@THIS > global.num_days } }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_EB_ct_cap_full_tt
				ROOT = { COLDWAR_EB_contract_has_room = yes }
			}
		}
		can_be_sent = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_EB_ct_cap_size_tt
				ROOT = { COLDWAR_EB_contract_size_fits = yes }
			}
		}
		cost = 25
		requires_acceptance = no
		icon = 17
		reset_send_effect = {
			ROOT = { COLDWAR_EB_contract_send_reset = yes }
		}
		send_scripted_gui = COLDWAR_EB_ct_send
		send_description = COLDWAR_EB_CONTRACT_BUY_SEND_DESC
		receive_description = COLDWAR_EB_CONTRACT_BUY_RECEIVE_DESC
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: diplomatic action COLDWAR_EB_contract_buy"
			# THIS = Western seller, ROOT = buyer of the Eastern Bloc
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_t_csize = ROOT.COLDWAR_EB_ct_send_size }
			COLDWAR_EB_contract_request = yes
		}
		ai_desire = { base = -1000 }
	}

	# Buyer ends the contract.
	COLDWAR_EB_contract_cancel = {
		allowed = { always = yes }
		visible = {
			has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			check_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_EB_ct_end@THIS > global.num_days }
		}
		cost = 0
		requires_acceptance = no
		icon = 17
		send_description = COLDWAR_EB_CONTRACT_CANCEL_SEND_DESC
		receive_description = COLDWAR_EB_CONTRACT_CANCEL_RECEIVE_DESC
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: diplomatic action COLDWAR_EB_contract_cancel"
			ROOT = { COLDWAR_EB_contract_cancel = yes }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_cn_by = ROOT.id }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EBC.5 } }
		}
		ai_desire = { base = -1000 }
	}

	# Seller ends the contract.
	COLDWAR_EB_contract_revoke = {
		allowed = { always = yes }
		visible = {
			has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_ct_end@ROOT > global.num_days }
		}
		cost = 0
		requires_acceptance = no
		icon = 17
		send_description = COLDWAR_EB_CONTRACT_REVOKE_SEND_DESC
		receive_description = COLDWAR_EB_CONTRACT_REVOKE_RECEIVE_DESC
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: diplomatic action COLDWAR_EB_contract_revoke"
			# THIS = buyer of the Eastern Bloc, ROOT = Western seller

				PREV = {
					COLDWAR_EB_contract_cancel = yes
